source: Nearly 90 million people who live in Temperate zones shift into harsher environments.
why: cities.csv has one row per city and no population field, so the 90 million population figure cannot be computed from this file.

source: Overall, there are 30 unique subclassifications, and together they make up the Köppen Climate Classification (KCC).
why: This describes the full Köppen system, not the 70 cities in this file: the file contains 16 distinct present-day subclasses (11 for 2070), and no computation from it yields 30.
cities.csv has no coordinates, latitude or region field, so a northward shift of Temperate climates cannot be measured from this file.

source: Within each climate subcategory, cities are ordered from highest average annual temperature top to bottom, left to right.
why: This is a display rule for how the chart sorts cities, not a finding measured from the data; the CSV is not stored in that order, and sorting by temp_2023 only restates the rule.
